title: Gap2: onboarding FROM the plugin should skip writing the npm hook chain into project .claude/settings.json?
context: The plugin supplies its own hook chain via runtime/claude-plugin/hooks.json. Today onboard/join/install always writes the npm hook chain into the project's .claude/settings.json (claude-adapter.ts). When onboard runs under the plugin (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT set) and still writes it, every plugin-onboarded repo becomes npm-wired too and both chains fire. Gap2 part 1 separately fixes the handshake to detect project settings so the plugin stands down when npm hooks are present.

options.label: When running under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, the Claude adapter omits the project hook chain (plugin supplies it); all other onboarding artifacts unchanged
Keep writing the npm chain; rely only on the Part-7 handshake for exactly-one-chain

rationale: Plugin supplies its own hook chain; writing the npm chain too makes both fire. Omit it when onboarding under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT.
